channel.title: ResponderTX · Flood Ops
channel.description: Flood warnings, watches and advisories, flash flood emergencies, forecast river crests, and active notices for Texas. Situational awareness, not a dispatch system; call 911 for emergencies.

item.title: Flood Advisory · Red River near Burkburnett
item.description: Flood Advisory issued October 15 at 8:39AM CDT until October 19 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Norman OK. In effect until Oct 19, 7:00 PM CT. Areas: Clay, Wichita. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.
